profile_text.body:
Apollo Global Management is a public company that describes itself on its website as an asset manager, capital provider, and provider of wealth and retirement solutions. The firm says it creates strategies it characterizes as innovative and differentiated, and it presents private credit as a way to promote resiliency in financial systems, fuel business growth, and power retirement income. It also publishes perspectives, case studies, and research on private markets, and it highlights long-duration capital and aviation expertise in work with an airline it does not name.

The site states that Apollo is addressing approximately $90T worth of investments needed to power what it calls the Global Industrial Renaissance. It says Apollo and Athene have been delivering investment solutions across the retirement ecosystem for more than three decades. No AI products, lawsuits, or other legal or regulatory matters involving the company are recorded.
